name: US inflation
summary: US CPI 4.0% in September, up from 3.7%, on the energy shock
state: Headline CPI rose 4.0% in the year to September, up from 3.7% in August, within the 3–4.5% Watch band. Brent fell about 3% to near $109 on 2 Nov but remains far above a year ago. The Fed held at 3.75–4% on 28 Oct; October CPI is due mid-November.
for_you: Higher US inflation keeps global interest rates elevated, which affects borrowing costs well beyond the US.

sources.title: AP — Global shares mixed and US futures advance, while oil prices fall

why: Inflation sets Fed policy and thus global borrowing costs; a resurgence would keep rates high for everyone.
drivers: Energy, tariffs, wages, housing costs, supply chains.

rubric.watch: CPI 3.0–4.5%, or rising for 3 consecutive months.
